svg.title: What data goes where
svg.desc: People enter account, collab and application data, stored in D1; only two on-demand AI calls send data out, never passwords, sessions, socials or other users' data.

text.font-family: Ultra, 'Rockwell Extra Bold', Rockwell, Georgia, serif
